skill.summary: Automatically installs and configures Gateway Watchdog to monitor Gateway status, enable DingTalk alerts, set up auto-start, and run the monitoring service.

latestVersion.changelog:
openclaw-gateway-watchdog 0.1.0

- Initial release of the Gateway Watchdog skill
- Enables automatic installation, configuration (with optional DingTalk notifications), autostart, and service running for Gateway monitoring
- Provides clear trigger phrases and step-by-step installation instructions
- Includes guides for configuration, command usage, and log checking
- Supports notification scenarios for startup, disconnection, restart success/failure, and daily status updates
